description: This Java class 'DittoGatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory' is a factory for creating authentication directives within the Ditto gateway service, handling configuration, provider setup, and authentication chain creation.

classes.name: DittoGatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory
classes.description: A factory class for constructing authentication directives for the Ditto gateway, supporting both HTTP and WebSocket authentication.

methods.name: DittoGatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with configuration, JWT factory, and dispatcher, and generating the authentication directive.

methods.name: buildHttpAuthentication
methods.description: Returns the pre-configured GatewayAuthenticationDirective for HTTP authentication.

methods.name: buildWsAuthentication
methods.description: Returns the pre-configured GatewayAuthenticationDirective for WebSocket authentication.

methods.name: generateGatewayAuthenticationDirective
methods.description: Static method that creates and configures the GatewayAuthenticationDirective based on provided authentication configuration and factories.
